description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a storage system within the 'secure_env' namespace of the 'cuttlefish' project. It includes a StorageData struct, a custom deleter class, factory functions for creating StorageData instances, and an abstract Storage class for key-value storage operations.

classes.name: StorageData
classes.description: Represents a binary data payload with a size and flexible payload array.

classes.name: StorageDataDestroyer
classes.description: A functor class that destroys StorageData instances and wipes their memory.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: An abstract interface for key-value storage with methods to check key existence, read, write, and verify storage presence.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Custom deleter for StorageData that wipes memory.

methods.name: CreateStorageData
methods.description: Factory functions to allocate StorageData with specified size or data.
